sections.A: Spinal stenosis mein kamar mein nerves ki jagah tang ho jati hai, aksar umar ke saath. Chalne ya khade rehne par nerves par dabao barhta hai aur aage jhukne ya baithne se kam hota hai.
sections.B: Aksar 50-60 saal se upar. Chalne ya khade rehne par kooleh aur taangon mein dard, bhaari-pan ya sunn-pan, aksar dono taraf, jo baithne ya aage jhukne se jaldi theek ho jata hai.
sections.C: Kitni door chal kar symptoms shuru hote hain, kya baithne ya jhukne se aaraam aata hai, aur kya peshab ya chaal mein tabdeeli hai.
sections.D: Posture (aksar jhuka hua), chaal, kamar ki extension par symptoms, neuro exam aur pair ki nabz.
sections.E: Walking tolerance test se napte hain ke patient kitna chal kar ruk jata hai aur kya cheez aaraam deti hai.
sections.F: Sab se ahem farq vascular claudication se hai: is mein pindli mein dard hota hai, khade rehne se aaraam aata hai aur nabz kamzor hoti hai.
sections.G: Saddle sunn-pan, peshab ya pakhane ki tabdeeli, tezi se barhti kamzori ya girna: foran referral.
sections.H: Chalne aur khade rehne par taang ke symptoms jo baithne ya jhukne se kam hon, aur nabz theek ho: working diagnosis stenosis.
sections.I: Aage jhukne wali halki mobilisation, aur hip aur thoracic mobilisation chalne mein madad kar sakti hai.
sections.J: Stationary cycle, trolley ya walking poles ke saath chalna, knee-to-chest aur taaqat ki exercises.
sections.K: Garmi aur TENS optional. Traction aur ultrasound routine nahi.
sections.L: Pehle CES aur khoon ki nali ki wajah screen karein, phir samjhayein ke symptoms sambhale ja sakte hain. Maqsad chalne ki salahiyat aur hosla barhana hai.
sections.M: Pehle symptom tak chalne ka faasla ya waqt, dard aur ODI dobara napein.
sections.N: 68 saal ki retired teacher 5 minute chal kar ruk jati hai aur baithne se aaraam aata hai. Khud socho, phir jawab dekho.
sections.chapter-summary-treatment-decision: Mukhtasar: education, aage jhukne wali exercise aur support ke saath chalna.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
